issues.title: Create icons using props not css-class
issues.body:
The icon and color for `AssetIcon` components are largely formatted using CSS-Styles.

This means they must be hard-coded within the game source code. But, the Game Designer is actually meant to create them in the Game Admin pages.

So, AssetIcon should format the icon using props, not css-styles.

The perception-management code should change, to allow this. Specifically, it should move away from providing CSS classes, instead provide actual color hexes and icon URLs.
